overview: Prop Hunt is a hide-and-seek playtest in Hollow Pine for one seeker and seven furniture-disguised hiders. A local solo preview lets players inspect the roles, while a separate server hosts the eight-seat match. Empty hider seats remain stationary disguises rather than behaving as roaming bots.
rules: Hiders choose a furniture disguise and confirm it; the seeker searches the environment.
The seeker has three minutes to find all seven hiders, as described by the catalog listing.
Holding the inspect action checks potential hiding objects.
Unoccupied hider seats remain stationary; online rounds require the game’s separate server.
controls: WASD moves; mouse looks; 1–0 or wheel chooses a disguise; E confirms.
The seeker holds Space to inspect.
Escape menu; F5/F9 save/load in solo preview.
story: Furniture disguises conceal hiders in Hollow Pine. No named personal backstories or narrative campaign are documented.

characters.name: Seeker
characters.description: The searching player, who inspects furniture for concealed opponents.

characters.name: Hiders
characters.description: Seven roles that disguise themselves as furniture; empty seats are stationary.
